notes: The italicized as thorns is marked added because no source morpheme licenses either word; the competing reading would fold it into the second le, which already holds in.
lakem in the first clause is read as recast into the possessive your on sides, leaving the preposition unrepresented (rule 40), while the lakem of the second clause takes the written unto you.
The le of le-moqesh is unrepresented because hayah carries the copula and the ASV writes no word for the resultative relation (rule 21).
